plays.description: Deep pass intended for Jauan Jennings is intercepted by Keisean Nixon. Commentary identifies double coverage and pressure from Zaire Franklin. Nixon returns it 11 yards.
Runs for a first down to Minnesota's 39, following a blocker captioned as Monk on the right.
Rolls on third-and-12 and throws out of bounds off his back foot.
Makes a 59-yard field goal.
Makes a difficult catch from Murray on third-and-four.
Escapes around the edge and gains six yards, adding yardage with a late move.
Catches a tight end screen on third-and-17 and reaches approximately the 45, leaving fourth-and-10.
Turns Love's first completion into an 81-yard touchdown, racing down the sideline. Commentary credits 60 yards after the catch and Matthew Golden's legal side-contact block; a flag is picked up.
Misses the extra point wide right after Watson's touchdown.
Scrambles and takes a collision, then clutches his left knee. An unnecessary-roughness penalty adds 15 yards; commentary identifies Bullard.
Catches a pass for a first down on third-and-six.
Has time against a four-man rush but misses an open Jordan Addison on third-and-five at the 20.
Makes a 38-yard field goal despite a Packers rusher nearly reaching the kick.
Returns the kickoff 59 yards to Minnesota's 40 before James Pierre forces him out.
A left tackle misses his block and Pace makes a tackle in the backfield. The ballcarrier and loss are not identified.
Catches a pass for a first down at approximately Minnesota's 27.
Right-side completion on third-and-nine is stopped short of the first down. Commentary names a defender captioned as Rogers.
Makes a 43-yard field goal, giving Green Bay scores on its first three drives.
Makes a catch on third-and-eight. Commentary discusses a possible hit to the quarterback's head.
Holds onto a catch with two defenders nearby for another conversion.
Catches Wentz's 39-yard touchdown on a free play caused by Lukas Van Ness being offside. Commentary describes a one-on-one matchup against an unnamed rookie.
plays.concept: deep left shot on free play

plays.description: Makes a catch and run for 23 yards. Captions call the throw down the middle; the DB records short left.
Commentary retrospectively identifies an earlier 30-yard reception; the original play call is absent from the supplied captions.
Catches Love's pass under pressure from Turner with 41 seconds remaining in the half. Love takes a hit after releasing.
Makes a 32-yard deep catch to Minnesota's seven despite defensive pass interference by Byron Murphy; the penalty is declined.
Catches a two-yard touchdown. Commentary says defensive backs look into the backfield, allowing Watson to slip behind them.
A handoff is mentioned immediately before halftime; the runner and result are unidentified.
Catches a 13-yard pass thrown by Love on the run.
Makes a first-down catch after commentary notes four consecutive running plays.
Gains 43 yards on a reception to Minnesota's seven. Isaiah Rodgers recovers ground to prevent a touchdown.
Misses Reed near the goal line as Van Ginkel and Cashman force a quick throw.
Makes a 26-yard field goal to extend the lead to 22-10.
Returns the kickoff 68 yards to Green Bay's 28. Commentary calls attention to DeeJay Dallas during the return.
Catches a quick pass after the long kickoff return.
Catches Wentz's 16-yard touchdown inside. Commentary says space is cleared in the middle for Hockenson.
Catches a jump pass from Love and makes a move after the catch.
Catches Love's pass on second-and-20 and cuts through the defense for 42 yards to Minnesota's 26.
Pass intended for Golden is deflected and nearly intercepted. Harrison Smith is identified contesting the coverage.
Commentary retrospectively refers to taking points off the board before the fourth-down attempt. The DB identifies a made 40-yard field goal nullified by Dallas Turner's offside penalty.

Fourth-down attempt comes up short according to the initial spot. Subsequent commentary discusses a tush push and identifies the situation as fourth-and-one; captions mangle the action as a 'kick by Love.'
Makes a first-down reception. Commentary mentions contact to the helmet and subsequently references two third-down penalties.
Breaks into the secondary for 28 yards to Green Bay's 11 and is tackled by Evan Williams. Commentary credits help from two tight ends without specifying the formation.

Throws an apparent end-zone interception with Jefferson described as one-on-one outside. A defensive penalty on number 29, identified as McKinney, gives Minnesota an automatic first down; the interception does not stand.
Scores from three yards on a toss around the left end. Commentary credits edge blocking, including Jennings coming down to block.
Catches Wentz's two-point conversion at the back of the end zone after Wentz escapes pressure.

Is hit on second-and-13 and loses the ball. Commentary credits Dallas Turner with creating the disruption and mentions a smart recovery without clearly identifying the recovering player. This precedes the separate third-down turnover.
On third-and-17, is sacked for a 12-yard loss by Andrew Van Ginkel and Blake Cashman. Van Ginkel forces and recovers the fumble, returning it seven yards to Green Bay's one.

Scores a one-yard rushing touchdown despite Wentz falling during the exchange. Replay commentary says Mason powers through Xavier McKinney and reaches across as Franklin closes. Green Bay's offside penalty is declined.
Pass intended for Watson is intercepted by James Pierre after a Harrison Smith deflection. Pierre returns it 28 yards to Green Bay's 14.
Catches a short right pass on third-and-five and dives through the air to the pylon for a nine-yard touchdown.
Catches a pass down the middle on second-and-10 late in the game.
Makes a 20-yard first-down reception on second-and-15. Love takes a heavy hit from Dallas Turner after releasing.
Is tackled by Harrison Smith on a late play immediately before the two-minute warning; the action leading to the tackle and yardage are omitted.
A late pass intended for Skyy Moore is unsuccessful, ending Green Bay's possession on a fourth-down stop.

offense_strengths: Produced explosive receptions through Watson (81 and 32 yards), Kraft (30 and 23), Jonnu Smith (43), and Golden (42 and 20).
Watson supplied both receiving touchdowns, including a long catch-and-run and a short score after defensive backs looked into the backfield.
Love completed passes while moving, including a 13-yard throw to Golden, and delivered other completions despite contact.
defense_weaknesses: Allowed Jefferson's 39-yard touchdown on an offside free play and Hockenson's 16-yard touchdown into space in the middle.
Allowed Mason's 28-yard left-end run and Jones's three-yard toss touchdown behind edge blocking.
Penalties extended Minnesota opportunities, including unnecessary roughness after Murray's scramble and the McKinney penalty that erased an apparent end-zone interception.
Could not finish the tackle before Jefferson reached the pylon on his late nine-yard touchdown.

offense_strengths: Jefferson made multiple third-down catches, scored twice, and caught the successful two-point conversion.
Hockenson contributed conversions and a 16-yard touchdown into space cleared in the middle.
The fourth-quarter running game produced Mason's 28-yard gain, Jones's edge touchdown, and Mason's one-yard score through contact.
Wentz exploited an offside free play with a deep touchdown to Jefferson and extended the two-point play before completing it.
defense_weaknesses: Allowed multiple explosive passes to four different Green Bay targets, including Watson's 81-yard touchdown with 60 yards after the catch.
Defensive backs' attention to the backfield allowed Watson to slip behind them for his short touchdown.
Murphy committed pass interference on Watson's 32-yard catch; the completion stood with the penalty declined.
Turner's offside penalty on a made fourth-quarter field goal gave Green Bay an opportunity to continue its possession.

limitations: Analysis uses only the supplied captions and DB excerpt; no video frames or external sources were consulted. The DB excerpt is selective, so NO DB MATCH does not mean a play did not occur. Caption timestamps mark the relevant call or retrospective reference, not game time. Personnel and formations remain unknown unless explicitly stated in commentary; DB shotgun labels alone were not used for that field. One-on-one and double coverage describe stated matchups, not a verified full defensive scheme. Named DB tacklers are labeled as such and are not necessarily defenders beaten in coverage. Yards on interception entries are return yards; the sack-fumble entry uses the offensive loss and states the separate return in its description. Field-goal yards are kick distances. Null yards indicate unavailable or inapplicable yardage. Several names, play transitions, penalties, and late-game actions are garbled or incomplete. The nullified interception and field goal are not counted as a turnover or score. Generic references to earlier running plays and the final snap lack enough detail to enumerate individual plays.
